description: This file defines the SageMakerRuntimeClient class for interacting with the Amazon SageMaker Runtime service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It contains method annotations for various operations such as invoking endpoints synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: SageMakerRuntimeClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon SageMaker Runtime service, extending the generic AWS client.

methods.name: invokeEndpointAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a SageMaker endpoint, returning a promise.

methods.name: invokeEndpointWithResponseStream
methods.description: Invokes an endpoint with response streaming support.
